notes:
Composed of {征|せい} (conquer, subjugate) and {伐|ばつ} (attack, punish). Implies a righteous or authoritative campaign against an enemy or rebel. Common in historical texts and folk tales, especially the story of {桃太郎|ももたろう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧{征伐|せいばつ}: demon slaying (as in Momotaro)
- {蝦夷|えぞ}{征伐|せいばつ}: subjugation of the Ezo people
- {征伐|せいばつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to set out on a punitive expedition
- {征伐|せいばつ}⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧: subjugation army

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{討伐|とうばつ}→討伐：14202_toubatsu⟧: subjugation, suppression — very similar, often interchangeable in historical contexts
- ⟦{征服|せいふく}→征服：12546_seifuku⟧: conquest — emphasizes bringing under one's rule
- ⟦{平定|へいてい}→平定：21861_heitei⟧: pacification — focuses on restoring peace after conquest
